background.text: What R2 demands, in the terms of the other requirements: If a runner collects their bib while they are not cleared to start, the system must send the runner to the medical desk.
What R8 demands, in the terms of the other requirements: When a runner drops out and is injured, the system must send them to the medical desk.
What R16 demands, in the terms of the other requirements: If a runner pays the entry fee and the payment is not accepted, the system asks for a new certificate.
What R18 demands, in the terms of the other requirements: The system must cancel the runner's registration when the runner misses the payment deadline for the second time.
What R19 demands, in the terms of the other requirements: When a runner transfers their registration to another person, the system must send a confirmation to the new runner.
What R29 demands, in the terms of the other requirements: If a runner's finish time is below the course record, the system must inform that runner of the new time.
What R31 demands, in the terms of the other requirements: When a volunteer signs up for a shift that has available places, the system must assign the volunteer to that shift.
The number of times a volunteer has missed a shift cannot be negative.
The number of warnings a runner has received from a referee cannot be negative.
The number of times a runner has lost a timing chip cannot be negative.
The number of times a runner has missed the payment deadline cannot be negative.
What N5 demands, in the terms of the other requirements: When a runner withdraws from the race, the system must not refund the entry fee.
What N7 demands, in the terms of the other requirements: When a runner asks for a certificate and their result is final, the system sends the certificate by email.

rules.text: WHEN a runner collects the bib AND the runner is cleared to start THEN the system hands out the bib and the timing chip
rules.reading: When a runner collects their bib and is cleared to start, the system must hand out both the bib and the timing chip.

probes.reading: The system hands out the bib and the timing chip only if the runner has collected the bib and is cleared to start.
If the runner collects the bib, then the system hands out the bib and the timing chip only if the runner is cleared to start.

rules.text: WHEN a runner collects the bib AND the runner is not cleared to start THEN the system sends the runner to the medical desk
rules.reading: If a runner collects their bib but is not cleared to start, the system must send them to the medical desk.

probes.reading: The system sends the runner to the medical desk only if the runner has collected the bib and is not cleared to start.
If a runner collects the bib, then the system sends the runner to the medical desk only if the runner is not cleared to start.

rules.text: WHEN a start wave is called AND the runner belongs to the wave THEN the system opens the start gate for the runner
rules.reading: Whenever a start wave is called and the runner belongs to that specific wave, the system must open the start gate for that runner.

probes.reading: The system opens the start gate for the runner only if a start wave is called and the runner belongs to that wave.
If a start wave is called, then the system opens the start gate for the runner only if the runner belongs to that wave.

rules.text: WHEN a start wave is called AND the runner does not belong to the wave THEN the system shows the runner the right wave
rules.reading: When a start wave is called and the runner does not belong to that wave, the system must show the runner the correct wave.

probes.reading: The system shows the runner the right wave only if a start wave is called and the runner does not belong to that wave.
If a start wave is called, then the system shows the runner the right wave only if the runner does not belong to that wave.

rules.text: WHEN a runner passes a checkpoint THEN the system records the split time of the runner
rules.reading: Whenever a runner passes a checkpoint, the system must record that runner's split time.

rules.text: WHEN the cut-off time of a checkpoint has passed THEN the system closes the checkpoint
rules.reading: Whenever the cut-off time of a checkpoint has passed, the system must close that checkpoint.

probes.reading: The system closes the checkpoint only if the cut-off time of that checkpoint has passed.

rules.text: WHEN a heat warning is in force THEN the system shows the warning at the start area
rules.reading: If a heat warning is currently in force, the system must display the warning at the start area.

probes.reading: The system shows the warning at the start area only if a heat warning is in force.

rules.text: WHEN a runner drops out AND the runner is injured THEN the system calls the medical team
rules.reading: If a runner drops out and is injured, the system must call the medical team.

probes.reading: If a runner drops out, the system must call the medical team, and the runner is injured.

rules.text: WHEN a runner drops out AND the runner is not injured THEN the system sends the sweep bus
rules.reading: When a runner drops out and is not injured, the system must send the sweep bus.

probes.reading: The system sends the sweep bus only if the runner drops out and is not injured.
If a runner drops out, the system sends the sweep bus unless the runner is injured.

rules.text: WHEN a runner loses a timing chip for the second time THEN the system charges the runner for the chip
rules.reading: If a runner has lost a timing chip and the count of such losses is exactly two, the system must charge the runner for the chip.

probes.reading: If a runner has lost a timing chip and the count of such losses is at least two, the system must charge the runner for the chip.

rules.text: WHEN a runner registers AND places are left THEN the system confirms the registration and assigns a bib number
rules.reading: Whenever a runner registers and there are still places available for the race, the system must confirm the registration and assign a bib number to the runner.

probes.reading: The system confirms the registration and assigns a bib number only if the runner has registered and places are left.

rules.text: WHEN a runner registers AND no places are left THEN the system puts the runner on the waiting list
rules.reading: If a runner registers and there are no places left for the race, the system must put the runner on the waiting list.

probes.reading: The system puts the runner on the waiting list only if the runner registers and no places are left.
If a runner registers, then the system puts the runner on the waiting list if and only if no places are left.

rules.text: WHEN a runner uploads a medical certificate AND the certificate is valid THEN the system marks the runner as cleared to start
rules.reading: If a runner uploads a medical certificate and the certificate is valid, the system must mark the runner as cleared to start.

probes.reading: The system marks the runner as cleared to start only if the runner has uploaded a medical certificate and the certificate is valid.
If a runner uploads a medical certificate, the system marks the runner as cleared to start only if the certificate is valid.

rules.text: WHEN a runner uploads a medical certificate AND the certificate is not valid THEN the system asks the runner for a new certificate
rules.reading: If a runner uploads a medical certificate that is not valid, the system must request a new certificate from the runner.

probes.reading: The system asks for a new certificate whenever a certificate is uploaded, regardless of its validity, but the 'not valid' condition is a separate, non-exclusive trigger.
The system asks for a new certificate if the certificate is not valid, even if it was not explicitly uploaded in the current session (e.g., checking existing records).

rules.text: WHEN a runner pays the entry fee AND the payment is accepted THEN the system sends the runner a receipt
rules.reading: If a runner has paid the entry fee and the payment is accepted, the system must send a receipt to the runner.

probes.reading: The system sends the receipt only if the payment is accepted, regardless of whether the payment event is explicitly recorded as a separate trigger.
The system sends the receipt if the runner has paid the entry fee, assuming that a paid entry fee implies the payment was accepted.

rules.text: WHEN a runner pays the entry fee AND the payment is not accepted THEN the system asks for another payment method
rules.reading: If a runner attempts to pay the entry fee and the payment is rejected, the system must request a different payment method.

probes.reading: The system asks for another payment method only if the runner has paid the entry fee and the payment was not accepted.
If a runner pays the entry fee, then the system asks for another payment method if and only if the payment is not accepted.

rules.text: WHEN a runner withdraws from the race THEN the system refunds the entry fee
rules.reading: Whenever a runner withdraws from the race, the system must refund the entry fee.

probes.reading: The system refunds the entry fee only if the runner has withdrawn from the race.

rules.text: WHEN a runner misses the payment deadline for the second time THEN the system cancels the registration of the runner
rules.reading: If a runner misses the payment deadline and this is the second occurrence, the system must cancel the runner's registration.

probes.reading: The system cancels the registration only if the runner has missed the payment deadline at least twice, meaning the cancellation applies to the second and any subsequent missed deadlines.

rules.text: WHEN a runner transfers the registration to another runner THEN the system sends the new runner a confirmation
rules.reading: When a runner transfers their registration to another runner, the system must send a confirmation to the new runner.

probes.reading: The system sends a confirmation to the new runner only if the runner has transferred the registration.

rules.text: WHEN a runner is a member of a running club THEN the system applies the club discount to the entry fee
rules.reading: If a runner is a member of a running club, the system must apply the club discount to their entry fee.

probes.reading: The system applies the club discount to the entry fee only if the runner is a member of a running club.

rules.text: WHEN a runner crosses the finish line THEN the system publishes the finish time of the runner
rules.reading: Whenever a runner crosses the finish line, the system must publish that runner's finish time.

probes.reading: The system publishes the finish time only if the runner has crossed the finish line.

rules.text: WHEN a protest against a result is open THEN the system does not publish any finish time
rules.reading: In any situation where a protest against a result is open, the system must not publish the finish time of the runner.

rules.text: WHEN a runner asks for a certificate AND the result of the runner is final THEN the system sends the certificate by email
rules.reading: When a runner asks for a certificate and their result is final, the system must send the certificate by email.

probes.reading: The system sends the certificate by email only if the runner has asked for a certificate and the result is final.
If the runner's result is final, then the system sends the certificate by email if and only if the runner has asked for a certificate.

rules.text: WHEN a runner asks for a certificate AND the result of the runner is not final THEN the system tells the runner the date of the final results
rules.reading: When a runner requests a certificate and their race result is not yet final, the system must inform the runner of the date when the final results will be available.

probes.reading: The system tells the runner the date of the final results only if the runner has asked for a certificate and the result is not final.
If the runner has asked for a certificate, then the system tells the runner the date of the final results only if the result is not final.

rules.text: WHEN the results of the race are final THEN the system ranks the runners in their age groups
rules.reading: If the race results are finalized, the system must rank the runners within their respective age groups.

probes.reading: The system ranks the runners in their age groups only if the results of the race are final.
The system ranks the runners in their age groups if and only if the results of the race are final.

rules.text: WHEN a runner receives a warning from a referee for the third time THEN the system disqualifies the runner
rules.reading: When a runner receives a referee warning for the third time, the system must disqualify the runner.

probes.reading: The system disqualifies the runner when the warning count reaches three or more, covering the third warning and any subsequent warnings.
